name: @string-utility-belt/mcp
description: MCP server exposing String Utility Belt's utilities and pipelines as tools for AI agents.

tools.name: list_utilities
tools.description: Search the utilities by category or keywords; start here.

tools.name: describe_utility
tools.description: Full documentation for one utility: params, accepted/produced types, examples.

tools.name: run_utility
tools.description: Run one utility on text, base64, hex or JSON input with validated params.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Run a multi-step pipeline (steps, branches, macros, conditions) or a String Utility Belt share link.

tools.name: detect_format
tools.description: Guess what an input is (JSON, YAML, base64, JWT, gzip, …), best match first.

timeout_ms.title: Per-call timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long a single tool call may run before it is stopped.
